title: Implement a Stack Using Queues
description: Implement a LIFO stack using queues. Operations: `PUSH x`, `POP`, `TOP`, `EMPTY`.
input_format: First line contains integer `m`. Following `m` lines contain commands.
output_format: Outputs of POP, TOP, and EMPTY separated by space.

sample_tests.explanation: TOP is 2, POP is 2, EMPTY is false.

hints: When pushing, append to the queue then rotate the previous elements behind it.
This guarantees that the newly inserted element is always at the front of the queue.
Pop and Top can then be executed in O(1) time.
